![](images/01/017f6c16cab79d3ae829676e7cb8afee853a3f232e072ea87fad7a865ff04d6a.png)

Which of the following sets of parametric equations, defined for $θ ∈ [0, 2π)$, generate the ellipse shown above?
worked_solution:
The dashed lines locate the center at $(2,1)$. The horizontal endpoints are $x=-2$ and $x=6$, while the vertical endpoints are $y=-1$ and $y=3$. Hence the radii are $4$ horizontally and $2$ vertically. Therefore

$$
x=4\cos\theta+2,\qquad y=2\sin\theta+1,\qquad0\le\theta<2\pi.
$$
